scope_note: Core advancement rules with the complete Only War Core Talent catalogue.

air_of_authority.name: Air of Authority
air_of_authority.summary: Extends the number and range of targets affected by Command.

ambidextrous.name: Ambidextrous
ambidextrous.summary: Reduces penalties for using either hand and fighting with two weapons.

armour_monger.name: Armour-Monger
armour_monger.summary: Improves the protective value of personally maintained armour.

arms_master.name: Arms Master
arms_master.summary: Reduces the untrained penalty for non-exotic weapons.

bulging_biceps.name: Bulging Biceps
bulging_biceps.summary: Removes the normal bracing requirement from suitable heavy weapons.

cold_hearted.name: Cold Hearted
cold_hearted.summary: Provides immunity to seduction and resistance to Charm.

combat_formation.name: Combat Formation
combat_formation.summary: Allows a squad to use the leader's Intelligence Bonus for Initiative.

combat_sense.name: Combat Sense
combat_sense.summary: Uses Perception Bonus instead of Agility Bonus for Initiative.

crack_shot.name: Crack Shot
crack_shot.summary: Increases Critical Damage caused by ranged attacks.

deadeye_shot.name: Deadeye Shot
deadeye_shot.summary: Reduces the penalty for ranged Called Shots.

die_hard.name: Die Hard
die_hard.summary: Improves the chance of surviving ongoing Blood Loss.

eye_of_vengeance.name: Eye of Vengeance
eye_of_vengeance.summary: Converts ranged Degrees of Success into additional Damage and Penetration.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.summary: Careful contemplation grants a bonus to a subsequent test.

hard_target.name: Hard Target
hard_target.summary: Makes the character harder to shoot while Charging or Running.

hardy.name: Hardy
hardy.summary: Always heals as though only lightly wounded.

hip_shooting.name: Hip Shooting
hip_shooting.summary: Combines a Full Move with a single ranged shot.

hotshot_pilot.name: Hotshot Pilot
hotshot_pilot.summary: Treats unfamiliar Operate specialisations as trained and improves successful tests.

into_the_jaws_of_hell.name: Into the Jaws of Hell
into_the_jaws_of_hell.summary: Nearby Comrades ignore Fear and Pinning.

iron_discipline.name: Iron Discipline
iron_discipline.summary: Makes Comrades substantially more resistant to Fear and Pinning.

jaded.name: Jaded
jaded.summary: Ignores mundane horrors while remaining vulnerable to warp-born terror.

lasgun_barrage.name: Lasgun Barrage
lasgun_barrage.summary: Adds a Degree of Success when firing Las weapons without moving.

light_sleeper.name: Light Sleeper
light_sleeper.summary: Remains alert to nearby activity while asleep.

lightning_reflexes.name: Lightning Reflexes
lightning_reflexes.summary: Rolls Initiative twice and keeps the better result.

master_chirurgeon.name: Master Chirurgeon
master_chirurgeon.summary: Improves advanced medical procedures and treatment of severe injuries.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.summary: Uses a short trance and Willpower test to remove Fatigue.

mighty_shot.name: Mighty Shot
mighty_shot.summary: Adds part of the Ballistic Skill Bonus to ranged damage.

paranoia.name: Paranoia
paranoia.summary: Improves Initiative and passive awareness of hidden threats.

precise_blow.name: Precise Blow
precise_blow.summary: Further reduces the penalty for melee Called Shots.

quick_draw.name: Quick Draw
quick_draw.summary: Draws and readies common one-handed weapons as a Free Action.

rapid_reaction.name: Rapid Reaction
rapid_reaction.summary: Uses an Agility test to act normally when surprised.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.summary: Further reduces the penalty for ranged Called Shots.

sidearm.name: Sidearm
sidearm.summary: Reduces penalties when using a pistol and melee weapon together.

sound_constitution.name: Sound Constitution
sound_constitution.summary: Adds one maximum Wound each time it is purchased.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.summary: Increases Full Move and Run distances, with Fatigue for repeated use.

storm_of_iron.name: Storm of Iron
storm_of_iron.summary: Spreads additional automatic-fire hits among a wider group of nearby targets.

sure_strike.name: Sure Strike
sure_strike.summary: Reduces the penalty for melee Called Shots.

target_selection.name: Target Selection
target_selection.summary: Allows ranged attacks into melee without the normal penalty.

total_recall.name: Total Recall
total_recall.summary: Recalls minor facts and details with exceptional accuracy.

true_grit.name: True Grit
true_grit.summary: Reduces Critical Damage by the Toughness Bonus after mitigation.

two_weapon_wielder_ballistic.name: Two-Weapon Wielder (Ballistic)
two_weapon_wielder_ballistic.summary: Allows attacks with a ranged weapon in each hand.

two_weapon_wielder_melee.name: Two-Weapon Wielder (Melee)
two_weapon_wielder_melee.summary: Allows attacks with a melee weapon in each hand.

unshakeable_faith.name: Unshakeable Faith
unshakeable_faith.summary: Allows failed Fear tests to be rerolled.

weapon_tech.name: Weapon-Tech
weapon_tech.summary: Temporarily improves the Damage and Penetration of advanced weapons.

weapon_training_bolt.name: Weapon Training (Bolt)
weapon_training_bolt.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Bolt weapons.

weapon_training_chain.name: Weapon Training (Chain)
weapon_training_chain.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Chain weapons.

weapon_training_flame.name: Weapon Training (Flame)
weapon_training_flame.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Flame weapons.

weapon_training_heavy.name: Weapon Training (Heavy)
weapon_training_heavy.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Heavy weapons.

weapon_training_las.name: Weapon Training (Las)
weapon_training_las.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Las weapons.

weapon_training_launcher.name: Weapon Training (Launcher)
weapon_training_launcher.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Launchers.

weapon_training_low_tech.name: Weapon Training (Low-Tech)
weapon_training_low_tech.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Low-Tech weapons.

weapon_training_melta.name: Weapon Training (Melta)
weapon_training_melta.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Melta weapons.

weapon_training_plasma.name: Weapon Training (Plasma)
weapon_training_plasma.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Plasma weapons.

weapon_training_power.name: Weapon Training (Power)
weapon_training_power.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Power weapons.

weapon_training_shock.name: Weapon Training (Shock)
weapon_training_shock.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Shock weapons.

weapon_training_solid_projectile.name: Weapon Training (Solid Projectile)
weapon_training_solid_projectile.summary: Removes the untrained penalty when using Solid Projectile weapons.

berserk_charge.name: Berserk Charge
berserk_charge.summary: Improves the attack bonus gained when charging.

blind_fighting.name: Blind Fighting
blind_fighting.summary: Reduces combat penalties caused by obscured vision.

catfall.name: Catfall
catfall.summary: Reduces falling damage and improves controlled jumps.

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.summary: Allows a successful opposed attack to remove an opponent's weapon.

disturbing_voice.name: Disturbing Voice
disturbing_voice.summary: Improves intimidation while making friendly social interaction harder.

double_team.name: Double Team
double_team.summary: Grants an additional melee bonus when outnumbering an opponent.

enemy.name: Enemy (choose group)
enemy.summary: A chosen organisation despises and may actively pursue the character.
enemy.unsupported_reason: Enemy is awarded by the GM and cannot be purchased as a normal advance.

ferric_summons.name: Ferric Summons
ferric_summons.summary: Extends the mass and range supported by Ferric Lure Implants.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.summary: Enters a controlled battle rage with physical bonuses and mental penalties.

heightened_senses.name: Heightened Senses (choose sense)
heightened_senses.summary: Grants a bonus to tests relying on one selected sense.
heightened_senses.unsupported_reason: Selecting and saving a Heightened Senses specialisation is not implemented yet.

iron_jaw.name: Iron Jaw
iron_jaw.summary: Allows a Toughness test to recover immediately from Stunning.

leap_up.name: Leap Up
leap_up.summary: Allows the character to stand as a Free Action.

orthoproxy.name: Orthoproxy
orthoproxy.summary: Improves resistance to mind control and interrogation.

peer.name: Peer (choose group)
peer.summary: Grants influence and a Fellowship bonus with one selected organisation.
peer.unsupported_reason: Selecting and saving a Peer organisation is not implemented yet.

polyglot.name: Polyglot
polyglot.summary: Provides an intuitive grasp of unfamiliar languages.

psychic_power.name: Psychic Power (choose power)
psychic_power.unsupported_reason: Psychic power selection is outside the current Guardsman-only character slice.

radiant_presence.name: Radiant Presence
radiant_presence.summary: Nearby allies gain confidence against Fear and Intimidation.

resistance.name: Resistance (choose threat)
resistance.summary: Grants a bonus when resisting one selected type of threat.
resistance.unsupported_reason: Selecting and saving a Resistance specialisation is not implemented yet.

street_fighting.name: Street Fighting
street_fighting.summary: Adds part of the Weapon Skill Bonus to unarmed or knife Critical Damage.

takedown.name: Takedown
takedown.summary: Provides a dedicated attack for stunning an opponent.

technical_knock.name: Technical Knock
technical_knock.summary: Clears a jammed weapon more quickly.

unarmed_warrior.name: Unarmed Warrior
unarmed_warrior.summary: Improves unarmed attacks and removes the usual unarmed disadvantage.

unremarkable.name: Unremarkable
unremarkable.summary: Makes the character difficult to remember or describe.

warp_sense.name: Warp Sense
warp_sense.summary: Allows active psychic awareness to function as an instinctive sense.

combat_master.name: Combat Master
combat_master.summary: Prevents opponents gaining the normal melee outnumbering bonus.

counter_attack.name: Counter Attack
counter_attack.summary: Permits an immediate attack after a successful Parry.

crippling_strike.name: Crippling Strike
crippling_strike.summary: Increases Critical Damage caused by melee attacks.

deflect_shot.name: Deflect Shot
deflect_shot.summary: Adds protection against Primitive ranged and thrown attacks.

exotic_weapon_training.name: Exotic Weapon Training (choose weapon)
exotic_weapon_training.summary: Removes the untrained penalty for one particular exotic weapon.
exotic_weapon_training.unsupported_reason: Selecting and saving an individual exotic weapon is not implemented yet.

furious_assault.name: Furious Assault
furious_assault.summary: Trades reactions for a second attack after a successful melee hit.

hatred.name: Hatred (choose enemy)
hatred.summary: Improves melee attacks against one selected enemy group.
hatred.unsupported_reason: Selecting and saving a Hatred target is not implemented yet.

independent_targeting.name: Independent Targeting
independent_targeting.summary: Allows multiple ranged targets to be farther apart.

inspire_wrath.name: Inspire Wrath
inspire_wrath.summary: Uses rhetoric to instil hatred and anger in a crowd.

killing_strike.name: Killing Strike
killing_strike.summary: Spends Fate to prevent normal avoidance of a melee attack.

luminen_shock.name: Luminen Shock
luminen_shock.summary: Discharges stored energy through a melee attack.

maglev_transcendence.name: Maglev Transcendence
maglev_transcendence.summary: Extends the duration and reserve of Maglev Coils.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.summary: Removes long- and extreme-range Ballistic Skill penalties.

mechadendrite_use.name: Mechadendrite Use (choose type)
mechadendrite_use.summary: Allows operation of one selected class of mechadendrite.
mechadendrite_use.unsupported_reason: Selecting and saving a mechadendrite class is not implemented yet.

munitorum_influence.name: Munitorum Influence
munitorum_influence.summary: Permanently improves the Squad's Logistics Rating.
munitorum_influence.unsupported_reason: Its additional XP surcharge depends on the Squad's current Logistics Rating, which OWCA does not track yet.

nerves_of_steel.name: Nerves of Steel
nerves_of_steel.summary: Allows failed Pinning tests to be rerolled and improves resistance to intimidation.

prosanguine.name: Prosanguine
prosanguine.summary: Uses an Autosanguine Implant to attempt self-healing.

strong_minded.name: Strong Minded
strong_minded.summary: Rerolls failed Willpower tests made to resist psychic powers.

swift_attack.name: Swift Attack
swift_attack.summary: Unlocks the Swift Attack melee action.

unarmed_master.name: Unarmed Master
unarmed_master.summary: Makes unarmed attacks substantially more dangerous.

warp_conduit.name: Warp Conduit
warp_conduit.summary: Spends Fate to temporarily increase Psy Rating at additional risk.

whirlwind_of_death.name: Whirlwind of Death
whirlwind_of_death.summary: Allows a separate melee attack against each nearby opponent.

assassin_strike.name: Assassin Strike
assassin_strike.summary: Uses Acrobatics to reposition safely after a melee attack.

bastion_of_iron_will.name: Bastion of Iron Will
bastion_of_iron_will.summary: Improves opposed defence against psychic powers.

blademaster.name: Blademaster
blademaster.summary: Rerolls one missed bladed-weapon attack each round.

blade_dancer.name: Blade Dancer
blade_dancer.summary: Further reduces penalties when fighting with two melee weapons.

crushing_blow.name: Crushing Blow
crushing_blow.summary: Adds part of the Weapon Skill Bonus to melee damage.

favoured_by_the_warp.name: Favoured by the Warp
favoured_by_the_warp.summary: Rolls twice for Psychic Phenomena and keeps the preferred result.

fearless.name: Fearless
fearless.summary: Provides immunity to Fear and Pinning, with limits on retreat.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.summary: Further reduces penalties when firing two pistols.

hammer_blow.name: Hammer Blow
hammer_blow.summary: Empowers a focused all-out melee strike with added penetration and impact.

infused_knowledge.name: Infused Knowledge
infused_knowledge.summary: Treats all Common and Scholastic Lore skills as known and improves successful lore tests.

lightning_attack.name: Lightning Attack
lightning_attack.summary: Unlocks the Lightning Attack melee action.

luminen_blast.name: Luminen Blast
luminen_blast.summary: Discharges stored bodily energy as a ranged attack.

master_enginseer.name: Master Enginseer
master_enginseer.summary: Improves Tech-Use and permits Fate-assisted automatic technical success.

master_orator.name: Master Orator
master_orator.summary: Greatly increases the audience affected by Charm and Intimidate.

mastery.name: Mastery (choose skill)
mastery.summary: Allows Fate to turn a failed selected Skill test into success.
mastery.unsupported_reason: Selecting and saving the mastered Skill is not implemented yet.

never_die.name: Never Die
never_die.summary: Spends Fate to ignore injury, Fatigue, and Stunning effects temporarily.

step_aside.name: Step Aside
step_aside.summary: Grants one additional Dodge or Parry attempt each turn.

thunder_charge.name: Thunder Charge
thunder_charge.summary: Uses an armoured charge to knock down and damage enemies.

warp_lock.name: Warp Lock
warp_lock.summary: Spends Fate to suppress a Psychic Phenomenon once per session.
